import Std.Tactic

namespace BlindColumnWorldWorld03

def companion : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => companion n + (3 * n ^ 2 + 3 * n + 1)

/-- Obligation 1 of 3: the base case, isolated from all algebra. -/
theorem companionBaseCase : companion 0 = 0 ^ 3 := by
  rfl

/-- Obligation 2 of 3: a pure polynomial identity. No induction appears here. -/
theorem companionSuccessorIdentity (n : Nat) :
    (n ^ 3) + (3 * n ^ 2 + 3 * n + 1) = ((n + 1) ^ 3) := by
  simp only [
    Nat.pow_succ,
    Nat.pow_zero,
    Nat.one_mul,
    Nat.mul_one,
    Nat.mul_assoc,
    Nat.add_mul,
    Nat.mul_add,
  ]
  omega

/-- Obligation 3 of 3: the induction skeleton. It cites the two lemmas above and
    performs no algebra of its own. -/
theorem companionClosedForm (n : Nat) :
    companion n = (n ^ 3) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [companion, ih]
      exact companionSuccessorIdentity n

end BlindColumnWorldWorld03

#eval IO.println "INVARIANT_LEAN_DEPENDENCY_AUDIT_V1_BEGIN"
#eval IO.println "target=BlindColumnWorldWorld03.companionClosedForm"
#eval IO.println "dependency=BlindColumnWorldWorld03.companion"
#eval IO.println "dependency=BlindColumnWorldWorld03.companionBaseCase"
#eval IO.println "dependency=BlindColumnWorldWorld03.companionSuccessorIdentity"
#eval IO.println "dependency=Nat.rec"
#eval IO.println "dependency=Nat.pow_succ"
#eval IO.println "dependency=Nat.pow_zero"
#eval IO.println "dependency=Nat.one_mul"
#eval IO.println "dependency=Nat.mul_one"
#eval IO.println "dependency=Nat.mul_assoc"
#eval IO.println "dependency=Nat.add_mul"
#eval IO.println "dependency=Nat.mul_add"
#eval IO.println "dependency=Lean.Parser.Tactic.omega"
#eval IO.println "result=checked"
#eval IO.println "INVARIANT_LEAN_DEPENDENCY_AUDIT_V1_END"
